title: Background jobs (SM37)
description: Lists background jobs, reads a job's steps, log and spool output, schedules an ABAP report as a job, and cancels one.

objects.name: ZCL_ZMCP_X_JOBS
objects.description: fluid: background jobs, log, spool, schedule

actions.name: list
actions.description: Lists background jobs from TBTCO matching a name pattern ('*' any chars, '+' one char) and optional scheduling-user, status and start-date-window filters. The date window is compared against the actual start date, or the scheduled start date when the job never started. max_rows caps the result (default 100; 0 means no limit) and truncated reports whether more rows exist.

name.description: Job-name pattern; '*' matches any chars, '+' matches one char. Default '*'.

user.description: Only jobs scheduled by this user (TBTCO-SDLUNAME). Default: any user.

status.description: Only jobs in this status. Default: any status.

from_date.description: Lower bound of the date window, YYYYMMDD. Compared against the actual start date, or the scheduled start date when the job never started.

to_date.description: Upper bound of the date window, YYYYMMDD. Compared against the actual start date, or the scheduled start date when the job never started.

max_rows.description: Row limit, as an integer written in text. Default 100; 0 means no limit.

truncated.description: True when more jobs matched than max_rows returned.

actions.name: show
actions.description: Reads one job's header from TBTCO, its steps from TBTCP, and its job log via BP_JOBLOG_READ. Omit jobcount to take the most recently scheduled job with this name. log_lines caps how many log lines come back (default 200; 0 means all); log_head returns the FIRST log_lines lines instead of the last.

jobcount.description: Job number. Omit to take the most recently scheduled job with this name.

log_lines.description: How many job-log lines to return, as an integer written in text. Default 200; 0 means all.

log_head.description: True returns the FIRST log_lines lines instead of the last.

spool_id.description: "" when the step produced no spool output.

external.description: True when TBTCP-XPGFLAG is set or XPGPROG/EXTCMD is filled, i.e. the step is an external program, not an ABAP report.

actions.name: spool
actions.description: Reads a job step's spool output via RSPO_RETURN_ABAP_SPOOLJOB, given a spool_id directly or resolved from a jobname (and optionally jobcount/step). max_lines caps the result (default 1000; 0 means no cap).

spool_id.description: Spool request number. Give this, or a jobname/step to resolve one from.

jobname.description: Resolve the spool id from this job's step. Ignored when spool_id is given.

jobcount.description: Job number. Omit to take the most recently scheduled job with this name.

step.description: Step number, as an integer written in text. Omit to take the last step that produced spool output.

first_line.description: First list line to return, as an integer written in text. Default 1.

last_line.description: Last list line to return, as an integer written in text. Omit for the end of the list.

max_lines.description: Hard cap on returned lines, as an integer written in text. Default 1000; 0 means no cap.

actions.name: schedule
actions.description: Creates a single-step background job running one existing ABAP report, optionally with an existing variant, via JOB_OPEN / JOB_SUBMIT / JOB_CLOSE; the step always runs under the calling (technical) user; OS commands and external programs are refused - the action has no input for them and the program must be an executable ABAP report (TRDIR-SUBC = '1').

program.description: Existing executable ABAP report (TRDIR-SUBC = '1'). Anything else is refused.

variant.description: Existing variant of that report. Must already exist; the action creates none.

start_date.description: Scheduled start date, YYYYMMDD. Omit for an immediate start.

start_time.description: Scheduled start time, HHMMSS. Only used with start_date; default 000000.

hold.description: True leaves the job scheduled but not released, so it never starts on its own.

actions.name: cancel
actions.description: Aborts a running job with BP_JOB_ABORT, or deletes a scheduled/released/ready one with BP_JOB_DELETE; a job that already finished or was cancelled is refused; by default only jobs scheduled by the calling user are touched, and any_owner lifts that - SAP's own S_BTCH_ADM / S_BTCH_JOB authorisations remain the real control.

any_owner.description: True allows acting on a job scheduled by another user. Refused by SAP unless the caller holds the background administrator authorisation.
